name: Cats In The Cradle Rescue (CITCR)
neighborhoods: Queens-based (Forest Hills); pulls from ACC citywide
notes: Queens nonprofit. Rescues social cats/kittens at high euthanasia risk from NYC ACC + found/surrendered cats; adopts via weekend events + Petco habitats + Petfinder. NOT the several out-of-state 'Cat's Cradle' orgs (OR/CA/NC/VA/BC). Intake: Adoption via weekend events, two Petco habitats & Petfinder Intake: contact via site/FB Other channel: PO Box 754078, Forest Hills 11375
